methodology.jit_symbolization: HotSpot DumpPerfMapAtExit, persisted per fork and restored before offline perf analysis
methodology.process_attribution: collector and workload PIDs parsed from immutable terminal output

attribution.ring_submission: Whole-process sample means are descriptive only; no equivalence test or warmed-window attribution was performed.
attribution.exact_capture: supported workload-latency component by the independent capture-domain paired control: 102.8 ms additional GetStackTrace time across 26080 additional admissions and a positive 123379..566421 ns per 100-operation interval
attribution.collector_polling: Not isolated from JVM startup, compilation, shutdown, or other collector work.
attribution.allocation_locking_publication: external allocation, lock, serialization, mapped-decoder, and argument controls do not establish a dominant workload-latency target

limitations: 21 maps did not cover nested workload JVMs.
Exit-time maps can omit retired compiled code and do not encode address reuse over time.
Counts of named JIT frames do not establish sample coverage.
Capture-domain cost proves a component, not exclusive attribution of remaining overhead.
